title: Repeated literal focus arguments for Reflection-Remaster
failure_signature: A pipe-separated focus string is interpreted as one literal term and yields an empty scoped inventory.
trigger_preconditions: The Reflection-Remaster runner must select more than one name fragment.
candidate_workaround: Pass one --focus option for each literal fragment.
recurrence_guard: Inspect repeatable argparse options before using regular-expression syntax.
rollback: Retain the zero-scope receipt with zero promotion credit and overwrite only its generated audit directory after recording the failure.
scope_boundary: Read-only inventory selection only; no destructive remaster or deprecation.
